name: tell-ai-monorepo
description: Monorepo for the tell-ai CLI and the @tell-ai/sdk browser-safe AI library

scripts.build: bun run --filter @tell-ai/sdk build && bun run --filter tell-ai build
scripts.lint: bun run --filter @tell-ai/sdk lint && bun run --filter tell-ai lint
scripts.ci: bun run build && bun run lint && bun run check && bun run test

author: it is not savio
